title: Promising the reeve to seal the barrow (turn 8) locked out the priest's blessing later, and the only place that consequence was explained was the innkeep's aside minutes afterward ('Ask his blessing before promising the reeve... Promise first, and he wants his own way past it') -- a blind player has no way to know the ordering matters until after committing.
